_what: The hygiene guard's rules (tools/ci/check_hygiene.py). Names are listed as salted sha256 digests of their lower-cased words, never in plain text; `python tools/ci/check_hygiene.py digest --class CLASS TEXT` prints a new entry. Every allowlist entry names its rule and carries its reason; a dev_jargon entry names a file and the sha256 of each line it allows. A pending declaration names a ledger value by key path and digest, or a tool-written tracked file by the sha256 of its whole content, with its hits and the tool that clears them.
